title: Ruthless Cherry Bomb Freeze Edition Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Cherry Bomb Freeze Edition by Ruthless is an explosive take on cherry-flavoured vapes, blending the deep, syrupy taste of Cherry Confectionary with an icy menthol blast. The bold, candy-like cherry flavour delivers rich sweetness on the inhale, while the cool exhale enhances the fruitiness with a refreshing chill. The combination of intense fruit and ice makes for a vibrant and well-balanced vape that lingers with a crisp, clean finish. One of many outstanding flavours found in the wildly popular Ruthless Shortfill collection, Cherry Bomb Freeze Edition features a 70VG/30PG ratio for thick vapour production and a smooth inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. Ruthless has earned its reputation as a pioneer in the e-liquid world, crafting bold and uncompromising flavours that stand the test of time. Their commitment to quality ensures every bottle delivers a standout vaping experience.
